assertions.assertion: The denial reason code is CO-197.
The CPT code for the service is 93229.
The service is mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring.
The clinical indication documents recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and near-syncope.
The symptoms are intermittent and difficult to capture on standard ambulatory monitoring.
There is clinical suspicion of sick sinus syndrome (I49.5).
There is clinical suspicion of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9).
Prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended period.
